Model I was sensitivity analysis in participants without BMI ≥ 28 kg/m2(N= 20,431). We adjusted age, gender, height, SBP, DBP, FPG, BUN, TG, HDL-c, LDL-c, ALT, AST, family history of diabetes, smoking and drinking status

Model II was a sensitivity analysis performed on never smoker participants (N= 17,784). We adjusted age, gender, height, SBP, DBP, FPG, BUN, TG, HDL-c, LDL-c, ALT, AST, family history of diabetes, and drinking status

Model III was a sensitivity analysis performed on never drinker participants (N= 19,704). We adjusted age, gender, height, SBP, DBP, FPG, BUN, TG, HDL-c, LDL-c, ALT, AST, family history of diabetes, and smoking status

Model IV was sensitivity analysis in participants without adjusting smoking and drinking status (N= 24,506). We adjusted age, gender, height, SBP, DBP, FPG, BUN, TG, HDL-c, LDL-c, ALT, AST, family history of diabetes
